name: sysml-v2
description: SysML v2 / KerML language support: diagnostics, completion, navigation, formatting via sysml-lsp

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The language server is a WebAssembly module in a worker. It reads the model files this extension hands it and runs nothing on the machine, so a workspace does not have to be trusted for names to resolve.

sysml.library.path.description: A SysML standard library to resolve names against, as a path or a URI. Empty uses the copy built into the language server, which is the release the extension was published from. A directory here is read by the editor and handed to the server, so it may be anywhere the editor can read -- including a workspace nobody has checked out.

sysml.workspace.exclude.description: Directories in the workspace whose models are not part of this project -- a vendored corpus, someone else's model. Their names do not resolve and are not offered in completion. A file opened from inside one is still read together with the model files in its own directory and below, so that half a model does not report the other half as unresolved. Relative paths are taken from each workspace folder.

sysml.format.width.description: Columns a line may reach before formatting breaks it at the readiest joint of what is on it -- before an `else` sooner than before a sum. A line is measured in columns, so a character an em across counts as two. 0 leaves every line as long as it comes, keeping only the breaks you wrote. Takes effect when the language server restarts.

sysml.diagram.skin.description: How the diagram preview is painted: the name of a skin that ships (`default`, `mono`, `contrast`), or an object saying what to paint it in. A palette takes `page` (what a name written over a line is haloed in), `fill` (the inside of a box), `ink` (every line and letter), `background` (the canvas, transparent where nothing says otherwise), `kinds` (boxes painted otherwise, under the word the drawing writes in guillemets -- `part def`, `requirement def`, `package`, `comment`) and `relations` (lines painted otherwise, under the word the notation calls them by -- `satisfy`, `composition`, `dependency`). Colour says nothing the SysML v2 notation defines; the shapes carry the meaning either way. Takes effect when the language server restarts.

sysml.preview.openAutomatically.description: Open the diagram preview beside the editor whenever a SysML or KerML file is opened. Off by default: a panel that appears unasked takes half the window from the file you came to read. Ask for it with `SysML: Open Diagram Preview` or the button in the editor title bar.

sysml.trace.server.description: Log the traffic between VSCode and sysml-lsp in the output channel, for debugging.
